entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-03-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • UseKestrel(port) silently ignores port parameter on derived WebApplicationFactory from WithWebHostBuilder() #65877
  • Blazor Hybrid (WebViewRenderer) should support per-page/component render modes as no-ops #65875
  • Issue Triage Agent action fails when issue opened #65874
  • [OpenTelemetry] ASP.NET Core 11 does not fully implement the HTTP server semantic conventions #65873
  • [aw] Daily Test Quarantine Management failed #65872

Closed

  • Perf regression: json #65868
  • Minimal API validation docs should clarify that `AddValidation()` must be called from the endpoint assembly #65829
  • Quarantine VirtualizationTest.CanRenderHtmlTable and CanElevateEffectiveMaxItemCount_WhenOverscanExceedsMax failing intermittently #65853
  • LoggingConnectionMiddlewareCanBeAddedBeforeAndAfterHttps test failure #38086
    Test failures
